summary.text: MOSS TO-TAKT AS is a private limited company registered in Moss, founded 2001-09-05. Its registered activity: "Bilforretning." Its main industry code is 95.310 (reparasjon og vedlikehold av motorvogner). The register shows 43 employees and 3 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 196 366 751 NOK and the annual result was -12 025 758 NOK; operating income was up from 174 187 408 NOK in 2024. Registered leadership: Ketil Pinheiro Jacobsen (daglig leder) and Kjell Rune Hanssen (styrets leder), with 1 other board member. Recent changes in the register: employees set to 43 on 2026-10-13; latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-08-12.
